text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of fluctuating double vision, proximal muscle weakness (stairs), and distal weakness (arms) strongly suggests an autoimmune neuromuscular junction disorder. I recommend you undergo a Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody test and a Chest CT to rule out thymoma.
